Your customer journey today: a seasonal masterclass, then a jump straight to coaching

1

You already run a Christmas masterclass series, but there's no small paid step after it, so there's still no way to monetise the 95%* of your audience who aren't ready for your coaching yet.

2

And there is no way to find out who in your audience is actually qualified for your coaching before they get on a call.

*95% is an industry estimate, not your data.

Seasonal front door

Busy in December, quiet in March

The masterclass series and your Sober October programme open the door at set moments. The rest of the year, the only way in is a DM or "Work with me".

No first purchase

Free stays free

Someone who loves your masterclass has two choices today: apply for coaching, or leave. Most leave, and the trust you just built earns nothing.

Content treadmill

532 posts and a weekly episode

Growth still leans on the next post and the next podcast guest. When you step back, the lead flow steps back too.

The people who are curious about life without alcohol but aren't ready for coaching today have nowhere to say a small yes, so most of them say nothing.

My recommendation

A low-ticket No More Booze Reset that pays for your ads and fills your coaching calls

You already run a masterclass series, so you don't need another free class. What's missing is a small paid next step that works all year: a 7-day self-paced alcohol-free reset with an order bump, an upsell and a downsell. Meta ads put it in front of new sober-curious people every day, your Christmas masterclass points to it at the end, and the welcome page invites the people who want you personally to apply.

Makes the ads pay their way

Ready to work with you

Instant access · 7 short lessons · Workbook included · [Refund policy]

Sound familiar?

Nobody else would call it a problem. So why does it keep bothering you?

  • You're busy and capable, and you've started to wonder whether alcohol is giving you as much as it's taking, even though nobody around you would bat an eyelid.
  • "Just the one" on a Tuesday is rarely just the one.
  • You promise yourself a quiet week on Sunday, and by Friday the promise is gone.
  • You're curious about life without alcohol, but you can't picture a wedding, a work do or Christmas without a drink in your hand.

Here's what you'll learn

Seven days, one short lesson a day

01

Why willpower runs out

What's really going on when a dry week falls apart by Friday, and why it has nothing to do with being weak.

02

Your 6pm plan

Spot the moments the urge to pour a drink shows up, and have a simple swap ready before it does.

03

Nights out, sorted

What to say, what to order and how to enjoy the pub, the wedding or the work do without a drink.

04

Rewrite the story

Let go of "I'll be boring" and "I can't relax without it", and notice what's true for you instead.

05

Notice what changes

A simple daily check-in so you can see for yourself how your evenings and mornings feel.

06

Make it stick

Choose what comes after day seven, and a plan for the next 30 days if you want to keep going.

Questions

Before you start

Who is this for?

Anyone who's curious about life without alcohol and wants to take it off autopilot, without labels or shame.

How long does it take?

Seven short lessons, one a day. It's self-paced, so you can go faster or slower.

What's included, and how much is it?

Seven video lessons, the Reset workbook, the 6pm Plan swap list and a 30-day alcohol-free plan template, for [€27].

When do I get access?

Straight after checkout. Your Day 1 lesson arrives in your inbox from Olivia.

Is this the same as coaching with Olivia?

No. Olivia's coaching and mentoring is personal support, by application. The Reset is a self-paced program you can start today.

Is this medical advice?

No. It's coaching and education, not medical advice or treatment. If you drink heavily every day, talk to your GP before you stop.

Script 1 · Reel · 30 to 45 seconds

"Why Friday undoes the week"

Hook
"A lot of people start a quiet week on Monday and give up on Friday. Here's why that keeps happening." (to camera, warm room, same feel as your profile photo)
Body
"It's not a willpower thing. Drinking is a habit tied to moments: 6pm, the end of a long day, Friday night. If you don't have a plan for those moments, willpower runs out right on cue." (simple on-screen captions)
CTA
"I made a 7-day Reset that gives you that plan, one short lesson a day. Tap Learn more. Educational content, not medical advice."
Script 2 · Reel · 30 seconds

"Three things to order at the pub"

Hook
"Going alcohol free doesn't mean staying home. Here are three things to order at the pub." (Olivia holds up three fingers)
Body
"One: [your go-to alcohol-free pint]. Two: [your favourite mocktail order]. Three: [your simple standby]. And one line for anyone who asks why: [your favourite comeback]." (caption for each one)
CTA
"Day 3 of my No More Booze Reset is all about nights out. Link below."
Script 3 · Reel · 45 seconds

"Where to start with my work"

Hook
"People ask me where to start: the podcast, the masterclass, or working with me. Here's my honest answer." (walking, natural light)
Body
"If you're new here, start with my 7-day Reset. You'll see how I think about alcohol, try it for a week with a real plan, and know whether going deeper with me is right for you."
CTA
"It's called The No More Booze Reset and you can start tonight. Tap Learn more."
